capabilities.title: Acquire knowledge
capabilities.description: Ingest content (text, note, link), start a research mission, or raise a knowledge gap. Extracted statements become CANDIDATE nuggets awaiting human review — nothing becomes governed knowledge or changes a graph here.

capabilities.title: Search governed knowledge
capabilities.description: Search ACTIVE governed nuggets and computed wiki articles. A governance/research read, not a runtime answer path (runtime answers navigate the graph — KA Invariant 1).

capabilities.title: Read knowledge with provenance
capabilities.description: Read one nugget (by ref or canonical id) or one computed wiki article, with its provenance chain: sources, evidence spans, governance decisions, lineage and graph usage.

item_id.description: a nugget ref (KN-001:v2), a canonical id (KN-001), or a wiki key (process:<key>, subject:<key>, scope:<T>|<id>)
item_id.title: Item Id

examples: Why does KA say refunds need approval?

capabilities.title: Propose a revision
capabilities.description: Propose a changed statement for a governed nugget, or request its retirement. Creates a candidate that awaits human review; the ACTIVE version is unchanged until a person decides.

proposal_id.description: the candidate version ref that now awaits review
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

capabilities.title: Review a candidate
capabilities.description: Ask a person to approve or reject a candidate nugget (or a wiki edit). The operation waits for input in AgentX's form; the decision is KA governance's own (`decide`), made by the submitting user — never by an agent.

item_id.description: a PENDING_REVIEW / CONFLICT nugget ref, or a wiki proposal id (WP-…)
item_id.title: Item Id

capabilities.title: Resolve a knowledge conflict
capabilities.description: Ask a person to resolve a candidate that contradicts governed knowledge: accept the new statement, keep the existing one, merge them, or keep both with context.

screens.title: Sources
screens.description: Add sources (upload, paste, note, link, connectors); each source's versions, provenance and evidence at #/source/{source_id}.

screens.title: Research
screens.description: Start a research mission for a knowledge gap; a mission's runs, sources and candidates at #/mission/{mission_id}.

screens.title: Knowledge Wiki
screens.description: Readable articles computed from governed nuggets; edits become governance proposals.

screens.title: Nuggets
screens.description: Governed knowledge nuggets with versions, lineage and provenance; one nugget at #/nugget/{nugget_ref}.

screens.title: Reviews
screens.description: Candidates waiting for a person; conflicts at #/nuggets?view=conflicts and #/conflict/{nugget_ref}.

screens.title: Publications
screens.description: Approved knowledge and its graph change proposals; one proposal at #/change/{proposal_id}. No dedicated list screen yet.
